title: The Long Orbit
author: Felix Almeida
blurb: Emrys Galloway, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
